title: C link: TX-time BusyPercent sampler (R-02a-131) — smallest slice of b7z9.29
description: Smallest slice of b7z9.29 (decompose-first): R-02a-131 (MUST) BusyPercent MUST be TX-time based occupancy, MUST NOT be RSSI-derived — no sampler exists in any language. Add to lichen/subsys/lichen/link/rf_health.{c,h}: record_tx_airtime_us(airtime_us) accumulating TX time in a rolling window; busy_percent = TX time / window * 100 clamped [0,100]; window constant named per spec (RF_METRICS_WINDOW_SF=32 superframes * slot duration — for the sampler expose the window in ms as a config). No RSSI input anywhere in the path. Host CTest cases in lichen/tests/rf_health: zero, partial, saturation clamp, window slide. Parent residue stays (rolling window reset, MitigateInterference, periodic re-invocation).
